reviews.author: Jordan T.
reviews.text: Cleanest fade I have had in years. Booked online at lunch and was in the chair by 5.

reviews.author: Chris M.
reviews.text: Brought my son for his first real haircut. They were patient with him and he walked out grinning.

reviews.author: Andre W.
reviews.text: The hot towel shave is worth every dollar. Good music, no rush, fair prices.
